destinations.category: Spiritual Heritage, Beaches & Valleys
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Pleasant winter weather 18-28°C)
destinations.visa_requirements: Indian e-Tourist Visa required for international visitors.
destinations.local_transport: APSRTC buses, South Central Railway, Visakhapatnam Metro/autos, local taxis
attractions: 1. Tirupati - Tirumala Venkateswara Temple (World's most visited spiritual shrine)
2. Visakhapatnam (Vizag) - RK Beach, Submarine Museum & Kailasagiri hilltop
3. Araku Valley - Picturesque coffee plantations & tribal museum
4. Borra Caves - Ancient natural limestone caves near Araku
5. Gandikota - 'Grand Canyon of India' with fort overlooking Pennar river gorge
6. Lepakshi - Hanging Pillar Temple & monolithic Nandi bull architecture
7. Vijayawada - Kanaka Durga Temple & Undavalli Rock-cut Caves
8. Srisailam - Mallikarjuna Jyotirlinga Temple & Tiger Reserve safari
9. Horsley Hills - Scenic hill station in Chittoor district
10. Belum Caves - Second largest cave system in Indian subcontinent

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Andhra Veg Thali with Gongura Pachadi, Pappu (Dal), Avakaya Mango Pickle, Rasam, and Curd is 100% vegetarian staple.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Authentic spicy Andhra thali at local Messes costs ₹100-₹180.

accommodations.budget: TTD Guest Houses in Tirupati & APTDC Haritha Resorts (₹600 - ₹1,800/night)
accommodations.luxury: Novotel Vizag Varun Beach & Taj Gateway (₹9,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book Tirupati Balaji Darshan tickets online 2-3 months ahead on TTD official portal.
Take the Vistadome train coach from Vizag to Araku Valley for panoramic hill views.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Very safe state. Follow traditional dress code at Hindu temples in Tirupati and Srisailam.

destinations.category: Historical Heritage & Culinary Hub
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Comfortable winter weather, 18-28°C)
destinations.local_transport: Hyderabad Metro Rail, Rapido bike taxis, Uber/Ola auto-rickshaws, TSRTC city buses
attractions: 1. Hyderabad - Charminar, Laad Bazaar, Chowmahalla Palace & Salar Jung Museum
2. Golconda Fort - Majestic citadel & evening Sound and Light Show
3. Ramoji Film City - World's largest film studio complex
4. Qutb Shahi Tombs - Intricate Indo-Islamic royal mausoleums
5. Hussain Sagar Lake & Buddha Statue - Sunset boat ride & Tank Bund
6. Warangal - UNESCO Thousand Pillar Temple & Kakatiya Kala Thoranam
7. Ramappa Temple (Palampet) - 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage floating brick temple
8. Nagarjuna Sagar & Buddhavanam - World's largest masonry dam & Buddhist heritage
9. Ananthagiri Hills - Vikarabad lush green nature getaway & Musi river origin
10. Kuntala Waterfalls - Highest waterfall in Telangana state

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Famous Veg Dum Biryani, Khatti Dal, Paneer 65, Bagara Baingan; historic veg tiffin joints like Chutneys serve Guntur idli and 70mm Dosa.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Authentic world-class biryani at Hotel Shadab, Bawarchi, or Cafe Bahar costs ₹280-₹400.

accommodations.budget: Budget hotels in Lakdikapul or Secunderabad (₹1,000 - ₹2,200/night)
accommodations.mid_range: 3/4-star business hotels in Banjara Hills / Hitec City (₹3,500 - ₹6,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: Taj Falaknuma Palace (Palace stay) & Park Hyatt (₹25,000+/night)

practical_tips: Visit Golconda Fort early in the morning to beat the afternoon heat.
Try authentic Irani Chai at Nimrah Cafe right opposite Charminar.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Very welcoming city. Dress modestly when visiting active religious monuments.

destinations.category: Royal Palaces, Desert Safaris & Forts
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Cool desert winter weather 12-25°C)
destinations.local_transport: RSRTC buses, Jaipur Metro, autorickshaws, heritage train rides, auto/car rentals
attractions: 1. Jaipur (Pink City) - Amber Fort, Hawa Mahal, City Palace & Jantar Mantar
2. Udaipur (City of Lakes) - Lake Palace, City Palace & Jag Mandir Lake Pichola
3. Jaisalmer (Golden City) - Jaisalmer Fort, Sam Sand Dunes desert safari & Havelis
4. Jodhpur (Blue City) - Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada & Umaid Bhawan Palace
5. Pushkar - Sacred Brahma Temple, Pushkar Lake & Annual Camel Fair
6. Ranthambore National Park - Royal Bengal Tiger jungle safari
7. Mount Abu - Only hill station in Rajasthan & Dilwara Jain Temples
8. Chittorgarh Fort - Largest fort complex in India
9. Bikaner - Junagarh Fort & Karni Mata Temple (Rat Temple)
10. Ajmer - Sharif Dargah & Ana Sagar Lake

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Dal Baati Churma, Ker Sangri, and Gatte ki Sabzi are staple vegetarian traditional Rajasthani dishes.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Enjoy Unlimited Thalis at Rawat Mishthan Bhandar or Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar (LMB) Jaipur.

accommodations.mid_range: Converted Haveli stays in Udaipur or Jodhpur (₹3,000 - ₹6,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: Umaid Bhawan Palace & Taj Lake Palace Udaipur (₹35,000+/night)

practical_tips: Experience an overnight desert tent camping stay in Jaisalmer Sam Sand Dunes.
Bargain politely at Johari Bazaar and Bapu Bazaar in Jaipur.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Hospitable local culture ('Padharo Mhare Des'). Keep water handy during daytime sightseeing.

destinations.category: Heritage Ruins, Tech Hub, Coffee Hills & Beaches
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Pleasant weather 18-28°C)
destinations.local_transport: KSRTC buses, Namma Metro Bengaluru, autos, taxis, coastal trains
attractions: 1. Hampi - UNESCO World Heritage boulder-strewn ruins of Vijayanagara Empire
2. Bengaluru - Silicon Valley of India, Lalbagh Botanical Garden & Bangalore Palace
3. Mysuru (Mysore) - Grand Mysore Palace, Chamundi Hill & Brindavan Gardens
4. Coorg (Madikeri) - Coffee plantations, Abbey Falls & Raja's Seat
5. Gokarna - Serene Om Beach, Kudle Beach & Mahabaleshwar Temple
6. Chikmagalur - Birthplace of Indian coffee, Mullayanagiri Peak hike
7. Badami, Pattadakal & Aihole - Ancient rock-cut cave temples & Chalukya heritage
8. Bandipur & Nagarhole National Parks - Tiger, Elephant & Leopard safaris
9. Jog Falls - Second highest plunge waterfall in India
10. Murudeshwar - World's second-tallest Shiva statue on Arabian sea coast

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Pure vegetarian South Indian tiffins (MTR, Vidyarthi Bhavan Dosa, Idli-Vada with Sambhar & Coconut Chutney) are world famous.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Iconic joints like MTR Bengaluru or Brahmin's Coffee Bar serve breakfast for under ₹100.

accommodations.luxury: Evolve Back Kabini/Coorg & The Lalit Ashok (₹18,000+/night)

practical_tips: Rent a bicycle to explore the ancient ruins of Hampi.
Visit Mysore Palace on Sunday evening to see 100,000 illuminated light bulbs.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Safe and tourist-friendly state. Respect sacred temple traditions.

destinations.category: Backwaters, Ayurveda, Tea Gardens & Nature
destinations.best_time_to_visit: September to March (Pleasant green landscapes, ideal for houseboats)
destinations.weather: Tropical climate (22-32°C). Monsoon (June-August, lush green & ideal for Ayurveda therapy)
destinations.local_transport: KSRTC buses, prepaid taxis, auto-rickshaws, public ferry boats in Alleppey
attractions: 1. Alleppey (Alappuzha) - Houseboat cruise in Backwaters & Kuttanad paddy fields
2. Munnar - Endless Tea Plantations & Eravikulam National Park (Nilgiri Tahr)
3. Kochi (Cochin) - Fort Kochi, Chinese Fishing Nets, St. Francis Church & Mattancherry
4. Varkala - Cliffside beach overlooking Arabian sea & Janardanaswamy Temple
5. Wayanad - Edakkal Caves, Chembra Peak heart-shaped lake & Banasura Dam
6. Thekkady (Periyar) - Periyar Tiger Reserve lake boat safari & spice gardens
7. Kovalam - Lighthouse Beach, Samudra Beach & Ayurvedic wellness centers
8. Athirappilly - Scenic Waterfalls ('Niagara of India') near Thrissur
9. Kumarakom - Vembanad lake bird sanctuary & luxury backwater resorts
10. Poovar Island - Estuary where river, lake, sea, and beach meet

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Kerala Sadya offers 24 pure vegetarian/vegan coconut delicacies (Avial, Thoran, Olan, Payasam).
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Local eateries serve authentic Kerala rice thalis for ₹120-₹200.

accommodations.luxury: Traditional Luxury Houseboat & Kumarakom Lake Resort (₹16,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book a private houseboat overnight stay in Alleppey or Kumarakom.
Try an authentic Panchakarma Ayurvedic massage at an accredited clinic.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Top literacy and safe environment. Remove shoes before entering homes & shrines.

destinations.category: Dravidian Temples, Hill Stations & Cultural Heritage
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Comfortable 18-28°C weather)
destinations.local_transport: TNSTC buses, Chennai Metro, Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train, autos, taxis
attractions: 1. Madurai - Meenakshi Amman Temple (Towering Gopurams & 1000-pillar hall)
2. Mahabalipuram (Mamallapuram) - UNESCO Shore Temple, Pancha Rathas & Butterball rock
3. Chennai - Marina Beach (World's 2nd longest urban beach), Kapaleeshwarar Temple & Fort St. George
4. Ooty (Udhagamandalam) - Nilgiri Mountain Railway toy train, Botanical Gardens & Ooty Lake
5. Kodaikanal - Star-shaped Kodai Lake, Coaker's Walk & Pillar Rocks
6. Rameswaram - Ramanathaswamy Temple (Longest temple corridor in world) & Pamban Bridge
7. Kanyakumari - Southernmost tip of Indian mainland, Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar Statue
8. Thanjavur (Tanjore) - UNESCO Brihadeeswarar Temple (Great Living Chola Temple)
9. Coimbatore - Isha Yoga Center (112-ft Adiyogi Shiva Statue)
10. Chidambaram & Tiruvannamalai - Nataraja Temple & Annamalaiyar Temple

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Pure veg South Indian tiffins, Ven Pongal, Sambar Rice, Curd Rice, and Uttapam are universally served across Tamil Nadu.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Saravana Bhavan and local Annapoorna messes offer delicious pure veg meals under ₹120.

accommodations.luxury: Taj Connemara Chennai & Savoya Ooty (₹12,000+/night)

practical_tips: Take the heritage UNESCO Nilgiri Mountain Toy Train from Mettupalayam to Ooty.
Temple dress code: Cover shoulders and knees when visiting active Hindu temples.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Culturally rich and welcoming. Enjoy authentic Kumbakonam filter coffee.

destinations.category: Spiritual Capital, Taj Mahal & Cultural Heritage
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Cool winter weather 10-24°C)
destinations.weather: Summer (35-45°C, hot), Winter (5-22°C, cool & foggy in Dec-Jan)
destinations.local_transport: UPSRTC buses, Agra/Lucknow/Noida Metro, auto-rickshaws, Uber/Ola
attractions: 1. Agra - Taj Mahal (Wonder of the World), Agra Fort & Fatehpur Sikri
2. Varanasi (Kashi) - World's oldest living city, Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Ganga Aarti at Dashashwamedh Ghat
3. Ayodhya - Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir, Kanak Bhawan & Saryu River Ghats
4. Mathura & Vrindavan - Krishna Janmabhoomi Temple, Banke Bihari Temple & Prem Mandir
5. Lucknow - City of Nawabs, Bara Imambara, Chota Imambara & Rumi Darwaza
6. Prayagraj (Allahabad) - Triveni Sangam (Confluence of Ganga, Yamuna & Saraswati) & Allahabad Fort
7. Sarnath - Deer Park where Buddha gave his first sermon & Ashoka Pillar site
8. Jhansi - Jhansi Fort & Rani Lakshmi Bai historical sights
9. Vindhyachal & Chitrakoot - Sacred pilgrimage sites along Mandakini river
10. Dudhwa National Park - Tiger, Rhinoceros & Swamp Deer jungle safari
hidden_gems: Kachhpura village view of Taj Mahal

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Pure veg Mathura Peda, Banarasi Tamatar Chaat, Kachori Sabzi, Bedmi Puri, and Rabri Jalebi are staple food delights.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Famous street stalls in Varanasi and Lucknow offer world-famous street food delicacies under ₹50-₹150.

accommodations.budget: Hostels in Varanasi (Hosteller, Zostel) & Agra guesthouses (₹600 - ₹1,800/night)
accommodations.mid_range: 3-star hotels near Taj Mahal or Gomti Nagar Lucknow (₹2,500 - ₹5,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: Oberoi Amarvilas Agra (Taj view rooms) & Taj Mahal Lucknow (₹22,000+/night)

practical_tips: Experience the sunset Ganges River boat ride in Varanasi to watch the evening Ganga Aarti.
Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays for visitors.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Dress respectfully in religious temple towns.

destinations.category: Alpine Mountains, Snow Sports & Valleys
destinations.best_time_to_visit: March to June (Summer escapes) & December to February (Snowfall & skiing)
destinations.weather: Summer (15-28°C), Winter (-5 to 12°C, snow in high peaks)
destinations.local_transport: HRTC mountain buses, Kalka-Shimla Toy Train, private taxis, rented bikes
attractions: 1. Manali - Solang Valley snow adventure, Rohtang Pass, Hadimba Temple & Atal Tunnel
2. Shimla - Capital hill station, Mall Road, Jakhoo Temple & Ridge viewpoint
3. Dharamshala & McLeod Ganj - Dalai Lama Temple, Tsuglagkhang Complex & Bhagsu Waterfall
4. Spiti Valley - High altitude cold desert, Key Monastery, Chandratal Lake & Kibber
5. Kasol & Tosh - Parvati Valley nature trails, Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara hot springs
6. Dalhousie & Khajjiar - 'Mini Switzerland of India', pine forest meadows & Dainkund Peak
7. Kullu Valley - Beas river white water rafting & Dussehra festival grounds
8. Jibhi & Tirthan Valley - Great Himalayan National Park (UNESCO site) & trout fishing
9. Kaza & Hikkim - Fossil village & world's highest post office at Hikkim
10. Chamba - Ancient Lakshmi Narayan temple & Khajjiar lake landscape

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Himachali Dham (Rajma, Kadi, Madra cooked in brass pots), Siddu, and Tibetan Veg Thukpa/Momos are widely popular.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Cafe culture in Kasol and McLeod Ganj serves wholesome meals for ₹200-₹350.

accommodations.luxury: Wildflower Hall Shimla (Oberoi Resort) & Span Resort Manali (₹20,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book Rohtang Pass permit online ahead of time if traveling to high mountain passes.
Pack warm thermal layers even in summer for high altitude trips like Spiti.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Warm Himalayan hospitality. Avoid driving on mountain roads after dark.

destinations.category: Land of Gods (Devbhoomi), Yoga, Trekking & Char Dham
destinations.best_time_to_visit: March to June (Spring/Summer trekking) & September to November (Post-monsoon mountain views)
destinations.weather: Summer (15-30°C), Monsoon (July-August, heavy rains), Winter (-2 to 15°C, snow)
destinations.local_transport: GMVN buses, shared jeeps, taxis, Ganga river boats, trek ponies/palkis
attractions: 1. Rishikesh - Yoga capital of the world, Laxman Jhula, Beatles Ashram & White water river rafting
2. Haridwar - Har Ki Pauri ghat Ganga Aarti, Mansa Devi Temple & Kumbh Mela site
3. Nainital - Naini Lake boating, Mall Road, Naina Devi Temple & Snow View point
4. Mussoorie - 'Queen of the Hills', Kempty Falls, Mall Road & Gun Hill cable car
5. Auli - Premier skiing destination in India & Nanda Devi mountain peak views
6. Kedarnath & Badrinath - Sacred Char Dham Himalayan shrines
7. Jim Corbett National Park - India's oldest national park tiger safari
8. Valley of Flowers & Hemkund Sahib - UNESCO alpine floral trek
9. Ranikhet & Kausani - Panoramic 300km Himalayan snow peak views
10. Chopta & Tungnath - World's highest Shiva temple trek & Chandrashila summit

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Rishikesh and Haridwar are 100% pure vegetarian & alcohol-free holy towns; Kafuli, Aloo ke Gutke, and Kumaoni Thalis are completely plant-based.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Ashram dining halls and local dhabas serve unlimited wholesome satvik thalis for ₹100-₹150.

accommodations.budget: Yoga Ashrams in Rishikesh & GMVN Tourist Bungalows (₹500 - ₹1,800/night)
accommodations.luxury: Ananda in the Himalayas & JW Marriott Mussoorie (₹28,000+/night)

practical_tips: Register online on Uttarakhand Yatra portal for Char Dham Kedarnath/Badrinath pilgrimage.
Rishikesh is world renowned for certified 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training courses.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Respect holy rivers and ashram peace. Do not consume meat or alcohol in Haridwar and Rishikesh holy city zones.

destinations.category: Financial Capital, Cave Temples, Hill Stations & Forts
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Pleasant weather 18-28°C)
destinations.local_transport: Mumbai Local Trains & Metro, MSRTC buses, Uber/Ola, auto-rickshaws
attractions: 1. Mumbai - Gateway of India, Marine Drive, Colaba, Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus & Elephanta Caves
2. Pune - Shaniwar Wada, Aga Khan Palace & Sinhagad Fort
3. Ajanta & Ellora Caves (Aurangabad) - UNESCO World Heritage rock-cut Buddhist & Kailash temples
4. Lonavala & Khandala - Bhushi Dam, Karla Caves & Rajmachi Fort hill views
5. Mahabaleshwar & Panchgani - Strawberry farms, Elephant's Head Point & Venna Lake
6. Shirdi - Sai Baba Temple spiritual pilgrimage center
7. Alibaug - Kolaba Fort, Varsoli Beach & coastal beach getaway
8. Tadoba Andhari Tiger Reserve - Royal Bengal Tiger & leopard jungle safari
9. Nashik - Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga, Panchavati & Sula Vineyards wine tour
10. Matheran - Vehicle-free eco hill station with toy train

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Vada Pav, Pav Bhaji, Misal Pav, Puran Poli, and Kanda Poha are iconic 100% vegetarian Maharashtra staple dishes.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Iconic street food stalls serve hot Vada Pav and Misal Pav for ₹20-₹60.

accommodations.mid_range: 3-star city hotels & hill resorts in Lonavala (₹3,000 - ₹6,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: The Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai & The Leela (₹25,000+/night)

practical_tips: Take the morning ferry from Gateway of India to Elephanta Caves.
Experience Mumbai local train travel outside peak rush hours (11am - 4pm).
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Energetic and welcoming state. Watch out for crowded train rush.

destinations.category: White Desert, Asiatic Lions, Heritage & Temples
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Cool desert winter season 15-28°C)
destinations.local_transport: GSRTC buses, Ahmedabad Metro, auto-rickshaws, rental cars
attractions: 1. Rann of Kutch - Great White Salt Desert & Rann Utsav cultural festival
2. Gir National Park - World's only natural habitat of Asiatic Lions
3. Statue of Unity (Kevadia) - World's tallest statue (182m) & Sarovar Dam
4. Somnath Temple - First among the 12 sacred Jyotirlinga shrines
5. Dwarka - Dwarkadhish Temple & Bet Dwarka island
6. Ahmedabad - Sabarmati Ashram, Adalaj Stepwell & UNESCO Heritage Old City
7. Modhera Sun Temple - 11th-century Solar Temple & Surya Kund stepwell
8. Champaner-Pavagadh - UNESCO Archaeological Park & hill temple
9. Saputara - Gujarat's sole hill station in the Sahyadri range
10. Bhuj - Aina Mahal, Prag Mahal & Kutchi handicraft villages
hidden_gems: Lothal ancient Harappan Indus Valley civilization site
Marine National Park Narara reef walk

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Gujarat is world renowned for 100% vegetarian cuisine; full thalis, Dhokla, Handvo, and Fafda Jalebi are vegetarian staples.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Authentic Gujarati Thali at Agashiye or Gordhan Thal costs ₹350-₹600.

accommodations.budget: Hotels in Ahmedabad & tent stays in Bhuj (₹800 - ₹2,200/night)
accommodations.mid_range: Heritage Haveli stays & Gir lion resorts (₹3,000 - ₹6,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: Tent City Rann of Kutch & Taj Gateway Gir (₹15,000+/night)

practical_tips: Visit Rann of Kutch during a full moon night for magical white salt desert views.
Book Gir Lion safari tickets online at least 30 days in advance.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Gujarat is a dry state (alcohol restricted). Safe and peaceful environment.

destinations.category: Cultural Capital, Tea Gardens, Tigers & Heritage
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Pleasant winter weather 15-26°C)
destinations.local_transport: Kolkata Metro & Yellow Taxis, Tram system, NBSTC buses, Darjeeling Toy Train
attractions: 1. Kolkata - Victoria Memorial, Howrah Bridge, Dakshineswar Kali Temple & Park Street
2. Darjeeling - Tiger Hill sunrise over Kanchenjunga, Himalayan Toy Train & tea estates
3. Sundarbans National Park - UNESCO World Heritage mangrove forest & Royal Bengal Tiger boat safari
4. Kalimpong - Durpin Monastery, Deolo Hill & flower nurseries
5. Digha & Mandarmani - Popular sea beaches along Bay of Bengal
6. Shantiniketan - Rabindranath Tagore's Visva-Bharati University & Baul music
7. Murshidabad - Hazarduari Palace (Palace of 1000 doors) & Katra Mosque
8. Bishnupur - Terracotta temples & Baluchari silk sarees
9. Siliguri & Mirik - Gateway to North-East & Sumendu Lake
10. Dooars - Jaldapara National Park & elephant safaris

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Luchi with Alur Dom, Chholar Dal, Shukto, Rosogolla, and Mishti Doi are iconic vegetarian Bengali food items.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Famous street stalls in Park Circus and College Street serve Kathi rolls and Puchka for ₹20-₹60.

accommodations.luxury: The Oberoi Grand Kolkata & Windamere Hotel Darjeeling (₹15,000+/night)

practical_tips: Experience the iconic UNESCO Darjeeling Himalayan Railway Toy Train ride.
Visit Kolkata during Durga Puja festival (Sept-Oct) for mega cultural pandal displays.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Culturally vibrant and warm people. Enjoy traditional Bengali sweets.

destinations.category: Organic Himalayan State, Monasteries & Snow Lakes
destinations.best_time_to_visit: March to May (Spring blooms) & October to December (Clear mountain views)
destinations.weather: Summer (15-22°C), Winter (-2 to 10°C, heavy snow in North Sikkim)
destinations.visa_requirements: Indian e-Tourist Visa required + Inner Line Permit (ILP) for restricted areas.
destinations.local_transport: Shared Tata Sumo jeeps, private taxis, Gangtok ropeway
attractions: 1. Gangtok - MG Marg, Rumtek Monastery, Hanuman Tok & Cable Car ride
2. Tsomgo (Changu) Lake & Nathula Pass - High-altitude Indo-China border pass (14,140 ft)
3. Pelling - Skywalk, Pemayangtse Monastery & Kanchenjunga mountain view
4. Yumthang Valley & Lachung - 'Valley of Flowers' & Zero Point snow landscape
5. Ravangla - 130-ft Buddha Park statue surrounded by Himalayan peaks
6. Yuksom - First capital of Sikkim & Kanchenjunga trek base
7. Gurudongmar Lake - One of the highest sacred lakes in the world (17,800 ft)
8. Zuluk - Silk Route zigzag road loops & Thambi viewpoint
9. Namchi - Siddheshwar Dham (Char Dham replica) & Solophok hill
10. Teesta River - White-water rafting adventure from Melli

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Veg Momos, Veg Thukpa, Gundruk soup, Sel Roti, and Chhurpi cheese dishes are widely available.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Local eateries on Gangtok MG Marg serve momos and thukpa for ₹100-₹180.

accommodations.luxury: Mayfair Spa Resort Gangtok & Elgin Mount Pandim Pelling (₹14,000+/night)

practical_tips: Obtain Inner Line Permit (ILP) for visiting Nathula Pass and North Sikkim (Lachung/Lachen).
Sikkim is India's 100% organic state—plastic bottles are banned in many tourist zones.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Extremely clean and peaceful Himalayan state.

destinations.category: Rhinos, River Island, Tea Estates & Temples
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to April (Pleasant weather, ideal for Kaziranga safaris)
destinations.local_transport: ASTC buses, Brahmaputra ferries, auto-rickshaws, rental cars
attractions: 1. Kaziranga National Park - UNESCO sanctuary home to 2/3rd of world's One-Horned Rhinos
2. Majuli - World's largest river island on Brahmaputra River & Neo-Vaishnavite Satras
3. Guwahati - Kamakhya Temple (Shakti Peeth), Umananda Peacock Island & Brahmaputra cruise
4. Manas National Park - UNESCO Tiger & Elephant Biosphere Reserve
5. Sivasagar - Ancient Ahom Kingdom palaces (Rang Ghar, Kareng Ghar)
6. Jorhat - Tea capital of Assam & Tocklai Tea Research Institute
7. Tezpur - Agnigarh hill park, Cole Park & Brahmaputra bridge views
8. Haflong - Assam's only hill station & Jatinga bird valley
9. Dibrugarh - Lush green tea estates & Dehing Patkai rainforest
10. Hajo - Ancient pilgrimage confluence for Hindus, Buddhists & Muslims

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Aloo Pitika, Khar, Koldil (Banana flower curry), and Assamese Veg Thali are wholesome vegetarian dishes.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Traditional Assamese Thali at Paradise or Delicacy Guwahati costs ₹180-₹300.

accommodations.budget: Eco lodges in Kaziranga & Majuli bamboo homestays (₹700 - ₹1,800/night)
accommodations.mid_range: 3-star Guwahati city hotels & tea resort bungalows (₹2,500 - ₹5,500/night)
accommodations.luxury: IORA The Retreat Kaziranga & Vivanta Guwahati (₹12,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book Kaziranga jeep and elephant safaris in advance (open Nov to April).
Take the ferry boat from Jorhat to explore Majuli island.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Warm and hospitable tea-state culture.

destinations.category: Abode of Clouds, Living Root Bridges & Waterfalls
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to April (Dry pleasant weather) & June to September (Monsoon waterfall season)
destinations.local_transport: Shared local yellow taxis from Shillong, private tourist cabs
attractions: 1. Shillong - 'Scotland of the East', Elephant Falls, Umiam Lake & Police Bazar
2. Cherrapunji (Sohra) - Nohkalikai Falls (India's tallest plunge fall) & Mawsmai Caves
3. Dawki - Crystal clear Umngot River where boats float on air
4. Mawlynnong - Voted the 'Cleanest Village in Asia' & Sky Walk tree bridge
5. Nongriat (Sohra) - Double Decker Living Root Bridge bio-engineered by Khasi tribe
6. Laitlum Canyons - Panoramic green canyon edge overlooking deep valleys
7. Jowai & Krang Suri Waterfalls - Turquoise blue natural pool waterfall
8. Balpakram National Park - Canyon plateau & wildlife reserve
9. Mawsynram - Wettest place on planet Earth
10. Mawphlang Sacred Grove - Ancient protected virgin forest
hidden_gems: Phe Phe Falls in Jaintia Hills

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Vegetarian Jadoh, Rice with Dal & local organic veggies, Pukhlein (fried rice-jaggery cake) are widely available.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Local cafes in Shillong Laitumkhrah serve delicious meals for ₹150-₹280.

accommodations.luxury: Ri Kynjai Resort on Umiam Lake (₹16,000+/night)

practical_tips: Wear good trekking shoes for the 3,000-step trek down to Nongriat Double Decker Root Bridge.
Visit Dawki between November and February for crystal transparent river water.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Matrilineal Khasi culture. Very safe and respectful community.

destinations.category: Cold Desert, Pangong Lake, High Passes & Monasteries
destinations.best_time_to_visit: May to September (Sunny summer days 15-25°C, high mountain passes open)
destinations.weather: Summer (15-25°C, pleasant), Winter (-15 to 5°C, extreme cold & snow)
destinations.visa_requirements: Indian e-Tourist Visa + Protected Area Permit (PAP) for Pangong/Nubra.
destinations.local_transport: Local union taxis, rented Royal Enfield motorbikes, shared jeeps
attractions: 1. Pangong Tso Lake - High-altitude turquoise saltwater lake spanning India and Tibet
2. Leh - Leh Palace, Shanti Stupa, Hall of Fame & Leh Main Bazar
3. Nubra Valley - Hunder double-humped Bactrian camel ride & Diskit Monastery
4. Khardung La Pass - One of the world's highest motorable passes (17,582 ft)
5. Magnetic Hill & Confluence - Gravity hill & Zanskar-Indus river Sangam
6. Tso Moriri Lake - Pristine high-altitude lake in Changthang plateau
7. Zanskar Valley - Chadar frozen river trek & Phugtal monastery
8. Kargil & Drass - Kargil War Memorial & Tiger Hill view
9. Hemis & Thiksey Monastery - Largest Buddhist monastic complexes
10. Lamayuru Monastery - Surrealistic 'Moonland' rock landscape
hidden_gems: Turtuk village (Last northernmost village of India)

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Veg Skyu, Chutagi, Veg Momos, Thukpa, and Tsampa (barley flour porridge) are staple vegetarian Ladakhi meals.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Local cafes in Leh Main Market serve wholesome Ladakhi meals for ₹180-₹300.

accommodations.mid_range: 3-star mountain view hotels & Pangong luxury tents (₹3,500 - ₹7,000/night)
accommodations.luxury: The Grand Dragon Ladakh & Chamba Camp Thiksey (₹22,000+/night)

practical_tips: Rest completely for 24-36 hours upon arrival in Leh to acclimatize to high altitude.
Apply for Inner Line Permit (ILP) online for Nubra Valley and Pangong Lake.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Extremely peaceful Buddhist culture. Keep oxygen cylinders handy during high pass travel.

destinations.category: Paradise on Earth, Dal Lake Shikaras & Skiing
destinations.best_time_to_visit: April to October (Lush flower valleys) & December to March (Gulmarg skiing & snow)
destinations.local_transport: Srinagar Shikara boats, tourist taxis, Gulmarg Gondola ropeway
attractions: 1. Srinagar - Dal Lake Shikara ride, Luxury Houseboats, Mughal Gardens (Shalimar/Nishat) & Shankaracharya Temple
2. Gulmarg - Asia's highest Gondola cable car, skiing slopes & Apharwat Peak
3. Pahalgam - Betaab Valley, Aru Valley & Baisaran ('Mini Switzerland')
4. Sonamarg - Thajiwas Glacier trek & alpine flower meadows
5. Katra (Vaishno Devi) - Sacred Mata Vaishno Devi cave shrine pilgrimage
6. Patnitop - Skyview ropeway, Nathatop & Sanasar meadows
7. Doodhpathri - Untouched 'Valley of Milk' stream meadows
8. Dachigam National Park - Endangered Hangul (Kashmir Stag) sanctuary
9. Jammu City - Raghunath Temple & Bahu Fort
10. Yusmarg - Serene pine woods & Sang-e-Safed valley river

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Kashmiri Dum Aloo, Nadru Yakhni (Lotus stem curry), Haakh Saag, Modur Pulao, and Kahwa tea are famous vegetarian delights.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Dine at local Shamyana or Mughal Darbar restaurants in Srinagar for authentic meals.

accommodations.budget: Standard Dal Lake Houseboats & Pahalgam lodges (₹1,000 - ₹2,500/night)
accommodations.mid_range: Luxury Dal Lake Houseboats & Gulmarg ski resorts (₹4,000 - ₹8,000/night)
accommodations.luxury: Khyber Himalayan Resort Gulmarg & Taj Dal View Srinagar (₹25,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book Gulmarg Gondola Phase 1 & 2 tickets online weeks in advance.
Stay overnight on a traditional carved wooden Dal Lake houseboat.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Warm Kashmiri hospitality ('Kashmiriyat'). Follow local tourist guidelines.

destinations.category: Tropical Island, Scuba Diving & White Sand Beaches
destinations.best_time_to_visit: October to May (Sunny, blue sea water, ideal for water sports)
destinations.weather: Tropical warm (24-31°C year-round). Monsoon (June-Sept, passing tropical rains)
destinations.visa_requirements: Indian e-Tourist Visa required. No RAP permit required for 30 open islands.
destinations.local_transport: Inter-island ferries (Makruzz / Green Ocean), auto-rickshaws, scooter rentals
attractions: 1. Port Blair - Historic Cellular Jail (Kala Pani) Light & Sound show, Corbyn's Cove
2. Havelock Island (Swaraj Dweep) - Radhanagar Beach (Voted Best Beach in Asia) & Elephant Beach scuba
3. Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep) - Bharatpur Beach coral reef, Laxmanpur Beach sunset & Natural Bridge
4. Baratang Island - Dense mangrove boat safari & Limestone Caves
5. Ross Island (Netaji Dweep) - British colonial ruins & wild deer sanctuary
6. North Bay Island - Sea walk, glass-bottom boat & snorkeling
7. Wandoor & MG Marine National Park - Coral reef sanctuary
8. Jolly Buoy Island - Pristine underwater coral view
9. Diglipur - Ross & Smith twin islands connected by a natural sandbar
10. Chidiyatapu - 'Bird Island' & panoramic sunset point
hidden_gems: Barren Island active volcano boat tour

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: North and South Indian vegetarian thalis, paneer butter masala, dal tadka, and fresh fruit juices are served across Port Blair & Havelock.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Dine at Ananda Restaurant or Full Moon Cafe in Havelock for delicious meals.

accommodations.budget: Guesthouses in Port Blair & beach huts in Havelock (₹1,200 - ₹2,800/night)
accommodations.luxury: Taj Exotica Resort & Spa Radhanagar Beach (₹28,000+/night)

practical_tips: Book private catamarans (Makruzz/Nautika) between Port Blair and Havelock in advance.
Scuba diving at Havelock Elephant Beach requires no prior swimming experience.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Clean and pristine environment. Do not touch or collect live corals.

destinations.category: Cultural & Modern Metropolis
destinations.best_time_to_visit: March to May (Cherry Blossom) and September to November (Autumn foliage)
destinations.visa_requirements: e-Visa available for many nationalities; single/multiple entry tourist visa required for Indian passport holders.
destinations.local_transport: Shinkansen (Bullet Train), Tokyo Metro, Suica/Pasmo IC cards, Kyoto city bus pass
attractions: Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa, Tokyo
Shibuya Crossing & Tokyo Skytree
Fushimi Inari Shrine (10,000 Torii gates) in Kyoto
Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion) & Arashiyama Bamboo Grove in Kyoto
Mount Fuji day trip (Lake Kawaguchiko)
hidden_gems: Kurama to Kibune mountain hike near Kyoto

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Buddhist Shojin Ryori cuisine available in temples; specialized vegan ramen shops in Tokyo and Kyoto.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Convenience stores (7-Eleven, Lawson, FamilyMart) offer fresh bento meals for under ¥600 ($4).

accommodations.luxury: Traditional Ryokans with private Onsen hot springs ($400+/night)

practical_tips: Always carry cash as small ramen shops and temples do not take credit cards.
Do not tip in Japan; it is considered disrespectful.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Extremely safe destination. Stand on the left side of escalators in Tokyo.

destinations.category: Romance, Art & Historical Heritage
destinations.best_time_to_visit: June to August (Summer events) and September to October (Milder crowd)
destinations.visa_requirements: Schengen Tourist Visa required for non-EU travelers.
destinations.local_transport: Paris RER and Métro system (Navigo Easy card / t+ tickets), Velib' bike share system
attractions: Eiffel Tower & Champ de Mars
Louvre Museum & Mona Lisa
Cathédrale Notre-Dame de Paris & Sainte-Chapelle
Montmartre & Sacré-Cœur Basilica
Palace of Versailles (day trip)

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Widely available across Paris; trendy vegan bistros in Le Marais and 10th Arrondissement.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Order the fixed-price 'Formule Déjeuner' lunch menu at local bistros.

accommodations.budget: Hostels in Canal Saint-Martin or Belleville (€40-70/night)
accommodations.mid_range: Boutique hotels in Latin Quarter or Montparnasse (€130-220/night)
accommodations.luxury: 5-star luxury hotels near Place Vendôme (€700+/night)

practical_tips: Book Louvre and Eiffel Tower tickets online at least 3-4 weeks in advance.
Greet shopkeepers with a friendly 'Bonjour' before asking questions.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Beware of pickpockets near Eiffel Tower and crowded Métro lines.

destinations.category: Futuristic Luxury, Shopping & Desert Adventures
destinations.best_time_to_visit: November to April (Warm, sunny, 20-28°C outdoor season)
destinations.weather: Summer (May-Sept, extreme heat 40-48°C), Winter (Nov-March, sunny & pleasant 18-28°C)
destinations.visa_requirements: Visa on arrival for select passports; 14-day & 30-day tourist visas easily issued online.
destinations.local_transport: Dubai Metro (Red and Green lines), Nol Card, Careem / Uber taxis, Dubai Ferry
attractions: Burj Khalifa (124th & 148th floor observation decks)
Dubai Mall & Dubai Fountain Show
Museum of the Future
Desert Safari with dune bashing, camel riding & BBQ dinner
Palm Jumeirah & Atlantis Aquaventure Waterpark
hidden_gems: Al Seef promenade along Dubai Creek

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Extremely veg-friendly; hundreds of South Indian, North Indian, and Middle Eastern vegetarian restaurants.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Explore Karama and Deira for delicious meals under 20-30 AED ($6-8).

accommodations.budget: Hotels in Bur Dubai or Deira ($50 - $90/night)
accommodations.mid_range: Hotels in Al Barsha or Business Bay ($110 - $200/night)
accommodations.luxury: Burj Al Arab & Atlantis The Royal ($800+/night)

practical_tips: Buy Metro Nol card at airport for seamless travel across Dubai transport.
Book Museum of the Future tickets at least 2 weeks ahead.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: One of the safest cities globally. Respect local laws.

destinations.category: Alpine Mountains, Scenic Trains & Nature
destinations.best_time_to_visit: June to September (Hiking) and December to March (Skiing)
destinations.weather: Summer (18-25°C), Winter (-5 to 5°C, snowy in alpine peaks)
destinations.visa_requirements: Schengen Visa required for non-EU travelers.
destinations.local_transport: Swiss Travel Pass (Unlimited trains, boats, and buses), SBB Mobile app
attractions: Jungfraujoch - Top of Europe (3,454m altitude)
Mount Titlis & Rotair revolving cable car
Matterhorn peak in Zermatt
Interlaken lakes (Lake Thun & Lake Brienz)
Glacier Express scenic train ride

food_and_cuisine.vegetarian_vegan_options: Rösti and cheese fondue are widely available; Haus Hiltl in Zurich is the world's oldest vegetarian restaurant.
food_and_cuisine.budget_food_tips: Buy picnic lunches from Coop or Migros supermarkets to save up to 60% on meals.

accommodations.luxury: 5-star grand luxury mountain resorts ($600+/night)

practical_tips: Get a Swiss Travel Pass if traveling for 3 days or more.
Check mountain weather webcams before taking cable cars.
destinations.safety_and_etiquette: Tap water from fountains is 100% fresh, drinkable mountain water.

faq_travel_tips.content: India features 28 States and 8 Union Territories offering diverse experiences: Rajasthan (Royal Forts & Deserts), Kerala (Backwaters & Ayurveda), Goa (Beaches & Nightlife), Himachal & Uttarakhand (Himalayan snow peaks & Yoga), Tamil Nadu & Andhra Pradesh (Dravidian Temples & Coastal Valleys), Karnataka (Hampi ruins & Coorg coffee), Uttar Pradesh (Taj Mahal & Varanasi spiritual ghats), and Telangana/Hyderabad (Nizam Palaces & Dum Biryani).
